lang.name: English
top.search_all_title: Find games, pages, settings and actions
common.guessed_title: The cover was guessed from the name. Change it on the game's page.
toast.shortcut_taken_body: {binding} is already used by another program. Pick another under Settings → Shortcuts.
toast.game_hidden_body: The launcher still reports it, so it was hidden rather than deleted. Bring it back from the library.
toast.replay_on_body: Everything older than the buffer is discarded continuously.
toast.frozen_hotkey_body: {name} is standing still. Press the same key to continue.
home.empty: No games yet. Install something in any launcher and GameHub picks it up by itself.
home.roulette_unplayed: Only games I have never started
library.title: Library
library.added_body: You can change the name and cover on the game's page.
library.empty: Nothing here yet. Install a game in a launcher and it shows up by itself — or press “Add game” and point at an .exe.
library.empty_favorites: No favourites yet. Press ★ on a game to put it here.
game.cover_guessed: The cover was guessed from the name. If it is wrong, change it here.
game.launch_unknown: GameHub does not know how to start this game.
game.save_dir_none: Not chosen. With a save folder, “Freeze now” also copies the save, which survives a restart.
game.freeze_points_none: None yet. Press {key} in the middle of a cutscene.
game.image_failed: The image could not be opened
game.remove_body: A game a launcher still reports is hidden rather than deleted, and can be brought back from the library.
game.saves_blurb: GameHub looked in the usual folders for something with the same name as the game. Pick the right one — if unsure, the one changed most recently is usually it.
game.saves_none: Found no folder that looks right. Use “Choose…” and point at it yourself.
quests.title: Quests
quests.blurb: Quests made from the games you own and how you play. Progress follows by itself — nothing to claim.
quests.empty: Quests appear once GameHub sees some installed games. Run a scan from the top.
quests.d_revisit: You have not played {game} in a month. Give it {minutes} minutes {span}
quests.d_new: Start a game you have never played and give it {minutes} minutes {span}
streaks.title: Streaks
streaks.blurb: A day counts once you have played long enough — the threshold is in Settings → Privacy. Nothing to start or stop.
streaks.tracking_off: Activity tracking is switched off in Settings → Privacy, so nothing new is being recorded.
cal.empty: Nothing played this month. Start a game and it appears here by itself.
replay.title: Replay
replay.blurb: The screen is recorded continuously, but only the last minutes exist — everything older is overwritten and never reaches the disk. {key} saves what you just saw.
replay.no_ffmpeg: Replay needs ffmpeg, and GameHub cannot find it. It normally ships with the installer from GitHub. Building yourself: run pnpm fetch-ffmpeg before building, or install ffmpeg so it is on PATH. The rest of GameHub works as normal.
replay.buffer_status: {have} of {total} in the buffer · about {mb} MB on disk
replay.buffer_idle: The buffer holds {total} when it is on · about {mb} MB on disk
replay.buffer_hint: A longer buffer only costs disk space, not performance. The change takes effect at once.
replay.save_hint: {key} saves the last {time}. Pick another length here:
replay.short_hint: If replay was switched on more recently than that, the clip is only as long as there is footage.
replay.empty: No clips yet. Switch replay on, play a bit, and press {key} when something happens — the clip lands here and under {folder}.
replay.delete_body: The file is deleted from disk.
freeze.title: Freeze the game
freeze.blurb: Press {key} in the middle of a cutscene, a dialogue or a mission where the game itself will not let you save. The game stops where it stands — every frame, every timer — and continues from exactly there when you want. At the same time the save folder is copied, so you have a point to go back to.
freeze.unsupported: Freezing is not available on this machine. Windows does not offer suspending processes here.
freeze.frozen_body: The game gets no processor time until you resume. The screen may stay on the last frame — press Win or Alt+Tab to reach the desktop. The freeze lasts as long as the PC is on; a restart ends the game, but the save copy stays.
freeze.save_known: The save folder is known, so a freeze also copies the save.
freeze.save_unknown: No save folder is chosen — open the game's page and press “Find” so the freeze also copies the save.
freeze.empty: No freeze points yet. Start a game and press {key} when you need a pause the game will not give you.
freeze.no_save_copy: · no save copy (no save folder was chosen)
freeze.skipped: {n} files were skipped for being too large.
freeze.delete_body: The save copy and the picture are deleted from disk. The game's own save is untouched.
freeze.restore_body: The game must be closed. What is in the save folder now is copied aside first, so this can be undone.
shots.title: Screenshots
shots.blurb: {n} pictures, filed under the game that was running. {key} takes a new one while you play.
shots.empty: No screenshots yet. Press {key} while playing and the picture is filed under the right game automatically.
clip.title: Clipboard
clip.blurb: The last 100 things you copied, on this PC only. Things that look like passwords or keys are skipped.
clip.empty_off: History is switched off, so nothing is recorded.
perf.title: Performance
perf.blurb: Real numbers from Windows. Frames per second and GPU temperature are not shown — GameHub would rather show nothing than a number that is wrong.
perf.outside: The game is running, but its processes are outside the folder GameHub knows.
perf.tools: If you want FPS and temperatures, MSI Afterburner with RivaTuner or Nvidia's own overlay does that job properly.
onb.found_blurb: This is what is on this PC. Nothing was changed — GameHub only read what your launchers already store.
langpick.title: Choose your language
langpick.blurb: You can change this later under Settings → General.
settings.title: Settings
settings.cat_general_blurb: Language, startup, tray and how often GameHub looks for new games.
settings.cat_appearance_blurb: Theme, colour, density, animations and background image.
settings.cat_replay_blurb: Buffer length, sound, quality and what {key} saves.
settings.cat_freeze_blurb: Shortcut, save folders and where freeze points go.
settings.cat_shortcuts_blurb: Every key, and what it does. All of them can be rebound.
settings.cat_screenshots_blurb: Which screen is captured, and where the pictures go.
settings.cat_folders_blurb: Extra folders GameHub should look in for games.
settings.cat_privacy_blurb: What is tracked about your playing, and how to delete it.
settings.cat_data_blurb: Where everything is, backups, and how to get them back.
settings.cat_updates_blurb: The version you run, and automatic updates.
settings.cat_artwork_blurb: Fetch missing covers, and your own keys if you have them.
settings.cat_assistant_blurb: AI help in the app. Off by default, and needs your own key.
settings.language_hint: Everything in the app changes at once.
settings.start_with_windows_hint: GameHub starts in the tray when you log in, so new games are noticed right away.
settings.tray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.tray_hint: Quit from the menu on the icon by the clock. In the tray GameHub uses no measurable CPU.
settings.scan_interval_hint: The folders launchers write to are watched anyway; this is a safety net.
settings.auto_add_hint: A game that appears in a launcher lands in the library without you doing anything.
settings.accent_hint: The colour of buttons, glow and highlights. Empty means the theme's own.
settings.density_hint: Compact fits more games per row.
settings.background_hint: Sits behind the animated background. Stays on this PC.
settings.replay_hint: Records the screen continuously. Can also be switched on and off in a game with {key}.
settings.buffer_hint: Everything older than this is overwritten continuously and never reaches the disk. 30 s – 10 min.
settings.save_seconds_hint: Footage shorter than this gives a shorter clip, never an error.
settings.clip_folder: Folder for clips and freeze points
settings.clip_folder_hint: Default: “Clips” in the data folder. Every game gets its own subfolder.
settings.system_audio_hint: What you hear in the speakers or headphones, without “Stereo Mix” or other tricks. Follows the default output device in Windows.
settings.mic_hint: Mixed in with the game sound.
settings.mic_none_found: No microphone found. Mixed in with the game sound when one is chosen.
settings.encoder_hint: The graphics card has its own video engine that sits idle while you play. Falls back to the processor if the card cannot.
settings.scale_hint: Never higher than your screen. The easiest place to gain performance.
settings.quality_hint: Higher quality means more disk per minute in the buffer.
settings.fullscreen_note: A game in exclusive fullscreen cannot be captured; switch to “borderless window” in the game. Almost every modern game offers it.
settings.save_per_game_hint: Chosen on each game's page (“Find” looks in the usual folders). With a save folder, a freeze also copies the save, which survives a restart.
settings.freeze_folder_hint: Same folder as the replay clips, under the game's subfolder: {path}
settings.freeze_note: Freezing suspends every process of the game with Windows' own mechanism (NtSuspendProcess). Games with anti-cheat (EasyAntiCheat, BattlEye, Vanguard) protect their processes and cannot be frozen — GameHub says so if that happens.
settings.shortcuts_hint: Click a key to change it, and press the new combination. Two actions cannot share one combination — GameHub says which one has it.
settings.monitor_hint: Applies to both {key} and the picture taken at a freeze.
settings.extra_hint: Games that belong to no launcher. Each subfolder is treated as one game; the .exe is picked automatically.
settings.track: Record playtime, streaks and the calendar
settings.track_hint: All of it stays on this PC. Off stops new recording at once; launching games is unaffected.
settings.threshold: A day counts towards the streak after
settings.clipboard_hint: The last 100 things you copy. Off also stops the watching entirely.
settings.clear_activity_hint: Playtime, streaks and calendar. Games and settings are kept.
settings.clear_body: Playtime, streaks and calendar history are deleted. Games and settings are kept.
settings.updates_hint: GameHub checks GitHub shortly after startup and asks before anything is installed. The update is signed and verified before it runs.
settings.updates_local: This build was made without an update key (for example locally with BUILD.bat) and does not update itself. Download the newest from GitHub Releases.
settings.refresh_art_hint: Steam covers are fetched automatically and need no key. Games from other launchers are matched by name.
settings.g_keys: Your own keys (optional, not wired up yet)
settings.assistant_hint: Can answer “what should I play?” from your library. Names and hours are sent to the provider you choose — never files.
data.recovered_title: A file had to be recovered from backup
data.recovered_restored: could not be read, so the newest backup was put back.
data.recovered_none: could not be read, and no backup had a readable copy.
data.original_kept: The original was not deleted — it is kept as
data.backups_hint: Deliberately outside the data folder: an update uninstalls the old version first, and Windows may then delete the data folder — the copies remain.
data.backup_now_hint: Also taken automatically before a new version starts for the first time. The ten newest are kept.
data.none: No backups yet. The first is taken automatically the next time you update.
data.restore_body: What you have now is backed up first, so this can be undone.
update.title: GameHub {version} is ready
update.body: The update is downloaded, checked against the signature and installed. GameHub restarts afterwards. Your library, settings, clips and freeze points are untouched.
update.err_network: GameHub could not reach the update server. Check the internet connection and try again.
update.err_signature: The update failed the signature check and was not installed.
update.err_404: No latest.json found for this version yet.
update.err_config: Updates are not set up in this build of GameHub.

settings.overlay_popup_hint: When GameHub is hidden, a small card in the bottom-right corner says what a shortcut just did: screenshot saved, clip saved, game frozen.
settings.overlay_sound_hint: A short pling with the popup, so you hear it even when you are not looking.
settings.popup_note: Games in exclusive fullscreen cover every window, this popup included. Set the game to borderless windowed (the default in most games) and it shows.
wp.title: Wallpapers
wp.blurb: Pick a picture for the lock screen and the desktop. GameHub keeps its own copy and hands it to Windows, so it stays after a restart.
wp.none: No picture chosen — Windows uses its own.
wp.remove_hint: Forgets GameHub's choice. The screen stays as it is.
wp.same: Use the desktop picture on the lock screen too
wp.same_hint: Copies the desktop picture to the lock screen.
wp.same_reverse: Use the lock screen picture on the desktop too
wp.same_hint_reverse: Copies the lock screen picture to the desktop.
wp.monitors_hint: Each monitor can have its own picture. Without one it shows the desktop picture above.
wp.unsupported: Wallpapers can only be set on Windows 8 or newer.
wp.lock_note: About the lock screen: Windows lets a program change the lock screen picture only for the signed-in user, through Windows' own API. It switches the lock screen from Windows Spotlight to “Picture”. Windows offers no way to read the current picture back, so this card shows what GameHub last sent. If a work or school policy locks the lock screen, Windows refuses and GameHub shows the reason.
be.wallpaper_bad_target: That is not a place a wallpaper can go.
be.wallpaper_bad_format: That is not a JPG, PNG, WebP or BMP picture.
be.wallpaper_unreadable: The picture could not be read: {0}
be.wallpaper_copy: The picture could not be copied into GameHub's folder: {0}
be.wallpaper_no_default: Windows' default picture was not found on this PC.
be.wallpaper_com: Windows' wallpaper service did not answer: {0}
be.wallpaper_lock_failed: Windows refused the lock screen picture: {0}
be.wallpaper_windows_only: Wallpapers can only be set on Windows.
settings.active_only_hint: Time counts while the game is the window in front. Alt-tab to Discord or the desktop and the clock pauses. A frozen game never counts. Off, a game left open in the background counts too.
settings.idle_hint: No keyboard or mouse for this long and the clock pauses until you are back. A long cutscene still counts if you keep it under this.
replay.trim_replace_hint: The original file is deleted and the trimmed clip takes its place.
sc.remove_hint: No key at all — the action is only reachable from inside the app. Backspace while listening does the same.
be.trim_too_short: A clip must be at least one second long.
settings.startup_animation_hint: A short logo animation the moment the window appears. Skipped when GameHub starts hidden in the tray.
settings.startup_sound_hint: A soft chime with the animation.
settings.startup_on_reopen: Also when brought back from the tray
settings.startup_on_reopen_hint: Play the opening every time the window comes back from the tray or the shortcut too — not only when GameHub starts.
settings.stats_note: So the developer can see how many people use GameHub, the app sends a small anonymous message every five minutes while it runs: a random install id, the version, the language, whether the window is open or in the tray, the game being played, how many games are installed and from which launchers, the Windows version, and how many times each feature was used. No name, no account, no file paths. Your IP address is not stored — only the country.
